limits: Exact published source artifacts and original license/copyright text are mapped to actual runtime artifact identities. This is not a byte-for-byte rebuild certification or legal opinion.

Only identified native AAR families were probed; language source JARs are not represented as containing JNI source. Camera/graphics get fixed native source/notice supplements, tree-sitter and ghostty reuse source-owned native evidence.
No source requirement is imposed on BOM/compileOnly graph nodes without runtime code. The confirmed statically-linked libyuv material is included despite its compileOnly packaging configuration.

Original root-license supplements are retained at fixed upstream source identities; per-file original copyright/license comments and available NOTICE/PATENTS files are preserved. No license body was synthesized.
